d: UP Election 2027:bihar men nitish kumar ke nam aur kam ke sahare ab uttar pradesh men siyasi jamin talashne ki taiyari hai... 2027 ke yupi vidhanasbha chunav ko lekar JDU ne varansi se chunavi shankhnad kar diya hai... korauta men aayojit rajy stariy karyakarta sammelan men bihar ke svasthy mantri nishant kumar, JDU ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha se lekar parti ke bare neta shamil hue... nishant kumar ne pita nitish kumar ke vikas modal ko yupi tak pahunchane ki bat kahi...vahin parti ne sushasan ke modal ko yupi ki janta tak pahunchane ki bat kahi...dekhie ye khas riport...
